relations.text: 米国・カナダ・日本以外でカボザンチニブを販売し、累計8.379億ドルのロイヤルティを支払う
relations.text_en: Sells cabozantinib outside the US, Canada and Japan; $837.9 million in royalties paid so far

source.label: Exelixis 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we have earned royalties of $837.9 million on net sales of cabozantinib by Ipsen since the inception of the collaboration agreement.

relations.text: 日本でカボザンチニブを独占販売
relations.text_en: Holds exclusive cabozantinib rights in Japan

source.label: Exelixis 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Takeda received exclusive commercialization rights for current and potential future cabozantinib indications in Japan

relations.text: ザンザリンチニブの臨床開発で協業(2024年10月)

source.label: Exelixis 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in October 2024, we announced our entry into a clinical development collaboration with MSD International Business GmbH, known as Merck within the United States and Canada (Merck).

companies.name: ロイヤルティ・ファーマ

relations.text: カボザンチニブ製品の売上の3%をロイヤルティとして支払う
relations.text_en: Pays it a 3% royalty on all cabozantinib sales

source.label: Exelixis 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we are required to pay a 3% royalty to Royalty Pharma on total net sales of any product containing cabozantinib, including net sales by Ipsen.

source.quote: licensed to Daiichi Sankyo Company, Limited (Daiichi Sankyo).

source.label: Adagene 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We advanced a third masked ADC program with Exelixis against a solid tumor target, building on the 2021 collaboration.

companies.name: ストラクチャー・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 初期段階の特許をExelixisに売却し1020万ドルの利益
relations.text_en: Sold early-stage patents to Exelixis for a $10.2 million gain

source.label: Structure Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Gains on sale of non-financial assets consists of the gain on sale of certain patents under the Exelixis Agreement.

relations.text: ExelixisがIconic社からADC(XB002)をライセンス導入し、Zymeworksも対価を受領

source.quote: Our closest competitors in this area include Genmab A/S, Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Bicara Therapeutics, Exelixis, Inc.
